layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and most prominent (red, bold). Flowchart and confusion matrices are secondary. Airplane illustrations and axis are tertiary visual elements.

visual_elements.description: Top confusion matrix: 2x2 grid with headers 'Predicted as' (columns P, N) and 'Actual' (rows P, N). Cells contain: row P -> TP, FP; row N -> FN, TN.
Bottom confusion matrix: 2x2 grid with headers 'Predicted as' (columns P, N) and 'Actual' (rows P, N). Cells contain: row P -> 3, 2; row N -> 1, 5.
Rectangular box with light background and red border containing text 'Threshold=0.6' in red.

Horizontal process flow: 'Test Sample' (with small airplane icon) -> arrow -> 'Model' (dark red box, white text, subtitle '[Any value] - (0, +∞)') -> arrow -> '(0 --- 1)' (blue outlined box) -> arrow -> 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' (red outlined box) -> splits into two arrows -> 'Class I' (green oval) and 'Class II' (purple/pink oval). A purple circle with a bell-curve graph sits to the right of the Model box.

Airplane illustrations (simple black line drawings) scattered across the lower middle area. Airplanes have small red dots or small blue dots. A vertical dashed blue/purple line runs through the scatter at approximately x=0.6.
Horizontal red axis line at bottom with arrowhead on right. Tick marks with labels: 0.0 at left, 0.5 at center, 1.0 at right. Vertical dashed line intersects near the 0.6 position.

imagery.description: Small airplane icon inside the 'Test Sample' box in the flowchart.
Simple line-drawing airplanes scattered across the bottom half of the slide, with red dots and blue dots.
Small bell-curve / distribution graph inside a purple circle next to the Model box.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, red, all words capitalized except prepositions. Body text is smaller, dark gray/black. Table text is centered in cells. Flowchart text is white on dark red for Model box, black elsewhere.
animation_state: All elements appear static and fully revealed; no mid-build animation visible.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add title text "Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance" at top-left spanning to center, in large bold red sans-serif font (color #C62828), occupying the top ~10% of slide height.
3. Add a yellow circle (accent color #FFEB3B) at the top-right corner containing the number "25".
4. On the far left, upper portion, create the top 2x2 confusion matrix table with white background (#FFFFFF), red borders (#B71C1C), and centered dark text (#212121). Column headers: "Predicted as" spanning columns "P" and "N". Row header: "Actual" spanning rows "P" and "N". Cell contents: row P -> "TP", "FP"; row N -> "FN", "TN".
5. Directly below the first table on the far left, create the bottom 2x2 confusion matrix table with identical styling and headers. Cell contents: row P -> "3", "2"; row N -> "1", "5".
6. Below the title, center-left, add a rectangular highlight-box with light background (#FFF3E0) and red border (#D32F2F) containing the text "Threshold=0.6" in red (#D32F2F).
7. In the center-right area, draw a horizontal flowchart:
   a. Place box "Test Sample" with a small airplane icon inside.
   b. Draw arrow to dark red box (#B71C1C) with white text (#FFFFFF) reading "Model" and subtitle "[Any value] - (0, +∞)".
   c. Draw arrow to blue-outlined box (#1565C0) with text "(0 --- 1)".
   d. Draw arrow to red-outlined box (#D32F2F) with text "Threshold (e.g. 0.5)".
   e. Draw two diverging arrows to a green oval (#4CAF50) labeled "Class I" and a purple oval (#9C27B0) labeled "Class II".
   f. To the right of the Model box, add a purple circle (#9C27B0) containing a small bell-curve graph.
8. Across the bottom-center area above the axis, scatter the simple black line-drawing airplanes (#000000). Add small red dots (#D32F2F) and small blue dots (#1565C0) to the airplanes as indicated in the source image.
9. Draw a vertical dashed line in purple/blue (#6A1B9A) through the airplane scatter at the 0.6 position.
10. At the bottom edge spanning full width, draw a horizontal red axis line (#D32F2F) with an arrowhead on the right end. Add three tick marks with labels "0.0" at left, "0.5" at center, and "1.0" at right in dark text (#212121).
